name: The Croods: Family Tree
s: Following the events in the feature film The Croods: A New Age, two very different families join forces to create a new community, an us-against-the-world, cave person co-op on the most amazing farm in the history of prehistory!

paragraphs.text: The Croods: Family Tree is an American animated television series that is produced by DreamWorks Animation under DreamWorks Animation Television. The series is based on the 2013 animated film The Croods, taking place after the events of The Croods: A New Age (2020). The series was released on September 23, 2021, while the eighth and final season premiered on November 9, 2023.
After the events of the sequel, the Croods and Bettermans must learn to get along in the Betterman treehouse.
